reports.rendered_content: The projection coverage engine evaluates spatial origins by sampling world-space surface area deterministically and proportionally, using double-sided BVH raycasting to reject geometry-hidden samples, ranking origin pairs via marginal union/joint complementary logic, and filtering imported-room interior candidates with triangle clearance rather than enclosing AABBs.
